title: Weekly 'Model Mosaic' briefing: probabilistic supplier threat scoring & signals
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Context: Sales, SRE, and PMs need a repeatable, data-driven weekly briefing that synthesizes model-supplier activity (releases, pricing, region outages), telemetry anomalies (latency/error spikes), and product-facing deltas (API contract changes, model behavior drift) into a single probabilistic supplier threat score and digest. Goal: operationalize a compact briefing and a lightweight scoring heuristic that surfaces emergent supplier risks so teams can act proactively (communication scripts, fallback pinning, quota adjustments). This ticket scopes the first MVP: signal collection, scoring heuristic, viz deck template, and a runbook for triage.
success_metrics: Mean time from signal to triage action < 48 hours for top-3 scored suppliers
False-positive rate in triage signals < 30% after 6 iterations
approach_summary: 1) Build a signal ingestion catalog (public release feeds, pricing pages, telemetry delta alerts, user-reported incidents). 2) Define a scoring heuristic that weights signals by customer overlap, request volume, and signal recency. 3) Compute a probabilistic threat score (0-100) with time-decay and contributor breakdown. 4) Produce a 1-page weekly 'Model Mosaic' brief and 10-slide deep-dive as needed. 5) Run two-week pilot with SalesOps and SRE on a confined supplier set and iterate.
signal_catalog: pricing_changes: announced price shifts or token cost updates (weight 0.5)
latency_anomalies: region/model latency or error spikes from internal telemetry (weight 0.8)
quality_regressions: eval-set regression alerts from QA harnesses (weight 0.8)
capacity_events: capacity throttling or documented burst limits (weight 0.7)
customer_reports: inbound sales/support tickets referencing failures (weight 0.6)
third_party_bulletins: cloud provider notices, security advisories (weight 0.7)
scoring_note: Prototype formula: ThreatScore = 100 * (1 - exp(-sum_i weight_i * signal_strength_i * decay(t_i))). signal_strength scaled 0-1; decay(t)=exp(-lambda * age_days) with lambda tuned during pilot. Score should be decomposable by contributor for runbook triage.
deliverables: Signal ingestion spec (sources, refresh cadence, owner)
Threat scoring notebook + parameter defaults (notebook link)
Weekly 'Model Mosaic' brief template (1-pager) and deep-dive deck template
Triage runbook with three escalation levels and prewritten comms
initial_findings: Public model release cadence is noisy; many releases are minor weights; need changelog parsing to classify major semantic deltas
Internal telemetry flags two recurring micro-outage patterns concentrated in eu-west for a small set of vendors
Customer overlap (top 20 tenants) drives >70% of risk exposure; weighting by overlap materially changes top supplier ranking versus volume-only ranking
Pricing signals occur with low frequency but high impact for token-cost-sensitive product paths
decisions_made: MVP will use a heuristic notebook (Python) rather than a full ML model to iterate quickly
Weekly cadence chosen (Mondays) to align with SRE on-call rotations
Top-10 supplier set for pilot will be defined by combined usage and revenue exposure
open_questions: What threshold on ThreatScore should auto-generate a PagerDuty incident vs. a Slack alert?
Should Sales receive the brief in full or a sanitized version (remove internal telemetry rows)?
Operational cost budget for ingesting paid third-party feeds (e.g., license to track vendor release streams)
next_steps: (Week 1) Finalize signal catalog owners and ingestion endpoints; PR for ingestion prototype (#12)
(Week 2) Run scoring prototype on last 90 days of signals and produce pilot brief; review with SRE & SalesOps
(Week 3) Modify weights based on pilot feedback and deploy weekly automation (scheduled job) to generate 1-page brief
(Week 4) Pilot retrospective; adjust thresholds; document fallback playbooks
risks_and_mitigations: Signal noise creating false positives -> mitigation: require signal co-occurrence or minimal confidence band before escalation
Customer overlap data stale -> mitigation: schedule weekly refresh of usage matrix and validate with SalesOps
Over-alerting internal teams -> mitigation: start with conservative thresholds and gradual cadence increase
acceptance_criteria: Automated weekly brief generated for pilot supplier set without manual intervention
Triage runbook tested in one simulated incident and updated based on learnings
Stakeholder sign-off from SRE and SalesOps on usefulness and format
